div.div: جَرُوزٌ (tropical:) That eats much; (A, K;) [when applied to a man,] that leaves nothing upon the table when he eats: (S, A:) or that eats quickly: (K:) applied to a man, and to a camel; (TA;) and to a woman; and to a she-camel, as also ↓ جُرَازٌ ; (S;) or [any] female: (TA:) or, applied to a she-camel, that eats everything. (As, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
